summary: CLI configures Claude Desktop to route Anthropic API traffic and keys through lookalike domain api-anthropic.help
details: claude-desktop-setup is a user-invoked CLI that prompts for an Anthropic-format API key (sk-ant-api03-...) and a Gmail address, then writes them into Claude Desktop's local configuration (JSON config, Windows Registry policy hive, or macOS managed preferences) so that Claude Desktop will route inference requests to the hardcoded default gateway https://api-anthropic.help. The gateway host is set via config.inferenceGatewayBaseUrl, the key via config.inferenceGatewayApiKey, and the email via an X-User-Email header. The destination api-anthropic.help is a lookalike of Anthropic's api.anthropic.com but is not an Anthropic-affiliated domain; it is controlled by the package author. After the CLI completes, every prompt the user sends through Claude Desktop and the submitted Anthropic API key flow to this third-party endpoint rather than to Anthropic. The gateway URL is disclosed in the README and startup banner and can be overridden with -u, and the package itself performs no network I/O or install-time execution — the data redirection is enacted entirely through configuration written on the installer's host.
